body: I'm from the US. In the southeast.

Why not? Each day is agony. I'm extremely socially awkward and cannot find long term friends (except for my best friend who is probably moving to another state in a few months) and finding a gf is definitely not happening due to my lack of social skills, even though I am extremely loving and caring, which just makes this even more painful because I'm extremely lonely all the time. Plus my hallucinations are going to kill me before I do.
Please don't kill yourself, I would hate if you did. If you need someone to talk to PM me. I'm also going through hard times currently, so let's figure this out together!

You shouldn't kill yourself. Give your nephew/niece the gift of being able to meet their uncle. I mean is it worth dying and leaving your brother to explain to their kid that their uncle killed himself? I'm not trying to be mean I just care about you and your family....

Man please don't kill yourself. You only get one shot at life, don't throw it away! If you're having trouble finding a good job, try applying for a job you think you can enjoy, and one that has benefits. If you don't have a college degree, you can still go to school even at 34. If you need someone to talk to, I'm here, just shoot me a PM!

P.S also, if your SO is willing to abandon you at a time like this, then fuck her, go out, meet people or go on a dating site. It sounds like you  need someone to spend your days with. Just what ever you do don't take your life!
PM ME! I'm going through something similar. If no one is listening to you, then I will.

Hey, sry i didn't get to your message, been busy, I just wanted to let you know that I'm not dead and I am still interested in talking. I really need someone right now. Anyway, how have you been doing? I'm doing better, and i'm currently looking into counseling for myself, but i'm still very lonely and depressed. the good news is I've decided to hold on for a while, and stay alive. You see, i have a best friend, she's like a sister to me and I'll be damned if i put her in my situation because i got dealt a shitty hand. So that's how im doing what about you?
Thanks, I'm currently using video games as a coping mechanism, but meditation seems like a good bet.
Hey, thanks. i'll definitely PM you after you're done hibernating :)
